title: Moving the Fetch into the Store

blocks.content: Course: Learn React Zustand: The Smarter Way to Handle Data
Moving the Fetch into the Store
What if the fetch lived in the store instead? Any component could trigger it. Any component could read the result.
In src/store/useJournalStore.js you add a fetchEntries action.
set({ isLoading: true }) — you can pass a plain object to set instead of a function. Zustand merges it into the store automatically.
try/catch handles both success and failure. If something goes wrong the error goes into the store where any component can read it.
Next, you will call this action and see real entries on screen. Click Next Lesson to continue.
